items.question: What alternative writing medium and leaf substrate should be used for performing the oblation rite?
premises: The rite is to be performed in the same manner as previously described.
The inscription is to be made on palāśa leaves.
Vermilion serves as the substance for inscription before the oblation.
items.inference: One should inscribe on palāśa leaves with vermilion and then perform the oblation in the same manner.
items.plain_english: In the same way, having inscribed on palāśa leaves with vermilion, one should perform the oblation.
